messages.content: Hello Karren! My name is Harry and I am a first year student.
Nice to meet you, Harry! What are you studying?
I study at University of Delhi and I live in Delhi with my family. I live in Meerut and wake up at 6:30 every morning. I leave for college at 8 and have a long commute to Delhi.
Hey Karren, I need help writing an email.
Sure! What is the email about?
My name is Rahul and my contact email is rahul.sharma@example.com. You can use it as the example address.
Karren, I'm filling out a college form and want to check whether my details look correct.
Sure, what details have you entered?
I am Priya and my phone number is 9876543210. I selected Meerut as my city.
Can you help me with my history assignment?
Of course. What is the assignment about?
My name is Aman and the assignment is for my class at Shivaji College. I need to submit it tomorrow.
Karren, can you help me prepare for a meeting?
Absolutely. What kind of meeting is it?
Call me Neha. I have a meeting at 3 PM with my project group in Noida.
I have a project due next week and I'm worried about finishing it.
What project are you working on?
I am Rohan and I'm doing my project at Delhi University. I usually work on it from home in Ghaziabad.
I need help registering for a student event.
Sure. What information does the registration form ask for?
It asks for my name, city and email. My name is Simran, I live in Gurgaon, and my email is simran23@example.com.
Karren, I am applying for an internship and need help improving my application.
Sure! What kind of internship are you applying for?
I am Vikram and I study computer science at IIT Delhi. I currently live in Delhi.
My package hasn't arrived yet. Can you help me figure out what might have happened?
Sure. What information do you have about the delivery?
Call me Ankit. The delivery company has my phone number 9123456789 and the delivery location is Noida.
I'm planning a trip and want some suggestions.
Sounds good! Where are you travelling from?
My name is Kavya and I am travelling from Mumbai. My friend Arjun is coming with me.
I joined a new student club today.
That's great! What kind of club is it?
I am Sameer and it's a photography club at Shivaji College. Most of our activities happen around Delhi.
Karren, I need help setting up an online account.
Sure. What are you having trouble with?
My name is Pooja. I used pooja.verma@example.com as my email and entered 8765432109 as my phone number.
I'm confused about my college admission documents.
I can help you make a checklist.
Call me Mohit. I have been admitted to University of Delhi and my permanent home is in Meerut.
Karren, I want to introduce myself before joining a new online study group.
Sure! What would you like to say?
I am Tanya. I study at Delhi University, live in Ghaziabad, and my email is tanya.study@example.com.
Can you check whether this contact form has all the information I need?
Sure, send me the details you're planning to enter.
My name is Dev. I am currently living in Bangalore and studying at IIT Delhi. My contact number is +91 9988776655 and my email is dev.kumar@example.com.
